name: libpipeline
description: C library for setting up and running pipelines of subprocesses without going through shell command-line parsing, avoiding its quoting pitfalls and injection risks. Required by man-db to build its formatter pipelines (e.g. zsoelim | tbl | nroff).
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
